text:
zoe: idea: run an interactive "benchmark lab" webinar where attendees submit prompts, we auto-score responses, and display a live leaderboard. doubles as a lightweight eval demo + lead qualifier
kai: love it. need to confirm infra for live scoring + scoreboard latency. mike can we run realtime scoring?
mike: yes but SLA depends on volume. we should cap concurrent submissions to 200 and queue rest. fallback plan: batched scoring + replayed leaderboard updates
lucas: product perspective: highlight model routing choices + quantization effects. demo should show same prompt across 3 model configs and scoreboard shows quality vs cost
sarah: want marketing assets too: short launch post, sample tweets, and a hero paragraph for the landing page. i'll draft

zoe: quick draft tweets (feel free to edit):
```
- Tweet 1: Join our free "Benchmark Lab" — submit a prompt, see models compete live. Learn cost vs quality tradeoffs. RSVP: link #inference #LLM
- Tweet 2: Curious which model wins your prompt? Our live leaderboard reveals tradeoffs + hackable configs. Save your seat: link
```

kai: run-of-show idea (55m):
- 0:00-0:05 intro + rules (zoe)
- 0:05-0:15 live demo: baseline vs tuned (lucas + mike)
- 0:15-0:35 attendee submissions + live scoring (ops streaming leaderboard)
- 0:35-0:45 panel quick analysis + tips (panel)
- 0:45-0:55 callouts + next steps (zoe)

zoe: registration form fields: email, company, role, opt-in_record (checkbox), interest_tag with options: "pilot", "bench-only", "partner". add hidden utm_campaign=benchlab_q2
sarah: landing hero copy draft: "Bring your prompt. Watch models compete. Learn how to serve smarter." 1-sentence CTA and link to privacy/consent

mike: engineering checklist:
- deploy scoring lambda pool
- leaderboard websocket + rate limiter
- synthetic test dataset uploaded to /tests/benchlab
- dry-run at Tue 10:00am
ops-bot: LEADERBOARD_TESTED: false

kai: rehearsal windows:
- Tue 09:30am 45m tech check (eng + ops + hosts)
- Tue 11:00am full run (50m)
- Wed 08:45am warmup (15m)

zoe: lead routing rules (proposal):
```
if opt-in_record==true AND interest_tag=="pilot" AND attended==true -> tag: "pilot_follow"; assign to SDR queue "bench-pilot"
else if attended==true AND submission_count>0 -> tag: "engaged_bench"; add to nurture list
```

lucas: scoreboard privacy: do not publish raw submissions. show anonymized handles (Attendee 1). capture consent checkbox for replay and leaderboard display

sarah: post copy for replay email: short subject "Replay: Benchmark Lab + your prompts" body: 1-sentence recap, link to replay, leaderboard snapshot, next step CTA (join pilot)

mike: fallback if live scoring crashes:
- switch to precomputed scoring of a curated batch (30s switch)
- show pre-populated leaderboard and explain reason in chat
ops-bot: RECORDING_ENABLED: true

kai: we need 3 volunteers (helpers) to seed prompts in first 10 mins to warm the scoring pipeline. @zoe can you recruit?
zoe: will ask growth + post in #help. also want a short incentive: top 3 get early access credit + swag

sarah: creative: hero social image with leaderboard mock and copy "Which model wins your prompt?" Nina from design do you have bandwidth?

mike: infra note: enable metrics for scoring latency (per-request), queue depth, and websocket p90. set alert for >5s median scoring

lucas: KPIs to track: live attendees, submission count, avg scoring latency, conversion to pilot, replay watches at 24h

zoe: post-event cadence: t+1h replay + leaderboard snapshot, t+48h targeted SDR outreach for pilot-tagged leads, t+7d nurture sequence for bench-only leads

kai: any legal check on leaderboard & consent? we have consent checkbox but confirm with legal. tagging @legal in #help

ops-bot: DEPLOY_LOCK: no infra deploys during event window (Wed 16:00-17:00 UTC)

zoe: final asks: design hero by Mon noon, landing copy + form by Mon 3pm, scoring dry-run Tue 10am, pre-seed prompts by Mon EOD. I'll assemble a short host script + run notes

mike: ack. scheduling dry-run now.

sarah: posting tweet drafts to scheduled queue after assets ready. will loop design + growth. :rocket:
